references.text: Luz is the original name of Bethel, which Jacob renamed after his dream of a ladder reaching to heaven.
Confirms that Luz is the same as Bethel, where Jacob built an altar for God.
Tells the story of Bethel, formerly called Luz, and how the name was transferred to a new city.
Describes the border of the tribe of Joseph running from Bethel to Luz and down to Lower Beth-horon, the same boundary area as in Joshua 18:13.
Mentions Ataroth-addar as a border town for the tribe of Ephraim, the same place mentioned in Joshua 18:13.
Mentions Beth-horon as an important location connected to Joshua's victory over the Amorite kings.
Solomon rebuilt Lower Beth-horon, confirming the site's significance in Israel's history.
